functions.name: get-webinar
functions.description: Get one webinar's details, API schedule IDs, presenters, registration links, and custom registration-field configuration.

webinarId.description: Opaque webinar ID returned by list-webinars; not the webinar hash.

FunctionInput_webinarjam_getwebinar.description: Select one account webinar by its opaque webinar ID.

type.description: Provider presentation type, or null when unspecified.

timezone.description: Named timezone for the local schedule times.

schedules.description: API schedules; several sessions in a series may share an ID.

id.description: API schedule ID, not the ID displayed in webinar settings.

localDateTime.description: Local scheduled date and time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm form, retaining any returned seconds or fractional precision; not a UTC instant.

items.description: One returned API schedule, retaining its position and local calendar time.

pictureUrl.description: Presenter image URL; empty string is preserved.

items.description: One presenter returned by the provider.

description.description: Webinar description, preserved without removing markup.

customFields.description: Custom registration fields when exposed by the webinar configuration.

type.description: Provider custom-field type; text and dropdown types have documented submission semantics.

label.description: Exact provider field label to use as the customFields map key during registration.

options.description: Selectable answers for a dropdown, omitted for text fields.

id.description: Opaque answer ID submitted when this option is selected.

items.description: One custom registration field and its provider submission identifiers.

registrationFee.description: Provider registration fee value; its monetary scale is undocumented and is not converted.

registrationUrl.description: Public registration URL, or empty string if returned empty.

registrationType.description: Provider registration pricing type, ordinarily paid or free.

directLiveRoomUrl.description: Generic direct live-room URL, not an attendee-specific registration link.

directReplayRoomUrl.description: Generic direct replay-room URL, not an attendee-specific registration link.

registrationCurrency.description: Registration currency as returned; an empty string remains empty.

registrationCheckoutUrl.description: Checkout URL when configured; may be empty.

registrationPostPaymentUrl.description: Post-payment URL when configured; may be empty.

FunctionOutput_webinarjam_getwebinar.description: Webinar details with API schedule IDs, local times, registration links, and available custom-field configuration.

tags.instructions: Obtain a webinar ID from `list-webinars`. Use this before `register-registrant` to obtain API schedule IDs and any custom-field labels and option IDs. Schedule IDs from the webinar settings UI are not interchangeable with these API IDs. Local scheduled times retain the returned timezone.

items.description: A state or province associated with this country.

Countries and their registration geography identifiers.

FunctionOutput_webinarjam_listcountries.description: The complete catalog of countries and their states or provinces.

tags.instructions: Use this before `register-registrant` when providing country and state information. This returns the provider's complete geography collection, with states nested under countries. Preserve IDs as opaque strings; do not substitute country abbreviations unless they are the returned values.

functions.name: list-registrants
functions.description: List one page of a webinar's registrants and attendee activity, optionally filtered by schedule, attendance, purchases, relative date range, or provider search text.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from the same webinar and identical filters; omit for the first page.

search.description: Provider search text; matched fields and matching rules are provider-defined.

purchase.description: Whether registrants purchased a product, according to the provider's aggregate purchase filter.

dateRange.description: Provider relative date-range preset; timezone, boundaries, and date basis follow provider rules.

scheduleId.description: Optional API schedule ID from get-webinar; omission includes all schedules.

liveAttendance.description: Live-session attendance filter; omission means all registrants.

mode.description: Attendance match: all, attended, not attended, or departure before/after the threshold.

thresholdSeconds.description: Provider departure threshold in seconds, required only for leftBefore or leftAfter; provisionally relative to the session timeline.

replayAttendance.description: Replay-session attendance filter; omission means all registrants.

mode.description: Attendance match: all, attended, not attended, or departure before/after the threshold.

thresholdSeconds.description: Provider departure threshold in seconds, required only for leftBefore or leftAfter; provisionally relative to the session timeline.

FunctionInput_webinarjam_listregistrants.description: Select a webinar, optional native report filters, and an optional continuation.

id.description: Webinar lead ID usable for unsubscribe-registrant; omitted if the provider does not expose it.

phone.description: Phone number as returned; preserve digits and leading zeros.

utmTerm.description: Provider campaign keyword value, retaining its original scalar type.

utmMedium.description: Provider campaign medium, retaining its original scalar type.

utmSource.description: Provider campaign source; retain its original scalar type because the documented type is ambiguous.

webinarId.description: Opaque webinar ID identifying the parent webinar.

scheduleId.description: Opaque API schedule ID associated with this registration.

signedUpAt.description: Registration instant normalized to UTC Z; provisional conversion from provider integer seconds.

utmContent.description: Provider campaign link variation, retaining its original scalar type.

liveRevenue.description: Provider live-room revenue value; currency and numeric scale are not inferred.

utmCampaign.description: Provider campaign identifier or name, retaining its original scalar type.

gdprStatusAt.description: GDPR choice instant normalized to UTC Z when present; source integer-second interpretation is provisional.

liveDuration.description: Provider live-room duration text, preserved without assuming units or format.

gdprIpAddress.description: IP address associated with the GDPR choice.

liveWatchedAt.description: Live viewing date normalized to UTC Z when a real date is present; integer-second interpretation is provisional.

replayRevenue.description: Provider replay revenue value; currency and scale are not inferred.

replayDuration.description: Provider replay-room duration text, with no inferred units.

smsConsentedAt.description: SMS consent instant normalized to UTC Z when present; integer-second interpretation is provisional.

liveEnteredTime.description: Provider live-room entry time text; timezone and units are not inferred.

replayWatchedAt.description: Replay viewing instant normalized to UTC Z when a real date is present; integer-second interpretation is provisional.

phoneCountryCode.description: Phone dialing prefix as returned, including a leading plus if supplied.

subscriptionStatus.description: Provider webinar-notification subscription code, preserved without assuming its value meanings.

liveAttendanceStatus.description: Provider live attendance status code, preserved without inventing boolean meanings.

items.description: One registration and its provider-reported attendee activity.
One provider-controlled page of matching registrant records.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation scoped to the same webinar and filters; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_webinarjam_listregistrant.description: One native registrant page with continuation when documented provider metadata permits it.

tags.instructions: Obtain webinar and API schedule IDs from `get-webinar`. Use attendance and purchase filters for attendee reports, or search text to narrow the same collection. Return nextCursor as cursor with all other inputs unchanged to continue; page size is provider-controlled. The returned registrant id is the lead ID for `unsubscribe-registrant`, not necessarily the attendee ID from `register-registrant`. Relative date ranges use the provider's calendar rules.

functions.name: register-registrant
functions.description: Register a person for a webinar schedule, including optional geography, phone consent, and custom registration answers. Registering through the first schedule of a series also registers the person for subsequent schedules.

email.description: Registrant email address used for this registration.

phone.description: Phone number using digits only; retain leading zeros. May be required by webinar configuration.

stateId.description: State/province identifier from list-countries for the selected country.

lastName.description: Registrant family name; may be required by webinar configuration. Omission leaves it unspecified; empty text is submitted as empty.

countryId.description: Country registration identifier from list-countries; omission supplies no country.

firstName.description: Registrant given name as ordinary Unicode text.

ipAddress.description: Registrant's IP address when intentionally supplied; omission does not substitute the integration server's address.

webinarId.description: Opaque webinar ID obtained from get-webinar.

scheduleId.description: API schedule ID from get-webinar; use the first schedule for a webinar series.

smsConsent.description: Registrant's actual consent to webinar SMS. Required by the provider when the phone field is enabled; omission never implies consent.

customFields.description: Answers keyed by exact custom-field labels from get-webinar. Text fields accept ordinary strings; dropdowns accept one option ID string or an array of option ID strings. Omitted keys are not submitted; empty text and an empty selection are submitted explicitly and may be rejected by required-field rules.

anyOf.description: Ordinary text answer or one dropdown option ID.
Distinct selected dropdown option IDs; an empty array explicitly submits no selection.

texasTimezone.description: Required for a Texas, USA registrant: mountain maps to Mountain Time (US and Canada), central to Central Time (US and Canada).

phoneCountryCode.description: Phone dialing prefix including plus, such as +1; may be required by webinar configuration.

FunctionInput_webinarjam_registerregistr.description: Registration details and actual registrant choices for one API webinar schedule.

email.description: Registrant email confirmed by the provider.

phone.description: Phone number as returned, preserving leading zeros.

stateId.description: Opaque state/province identifier returned for the attendee.

lastName.description: Registrant family name when enabled and returned.

password.description: Attendee's room password when returned; null means no password was supplied.

countryId.description: Opaque country identifier returned for the attendee.

firstName.description: Registrant given name returned by the provider.

stateName.description: State/province display name returned for the attendee.

webinarId.description: Opaque webinar ID confirmed by the provider.

attendeeId.description: Attendee internal user ID, not assumed to be the lead ID needed for unsubscribe-registrant.

scheduleId.description: API schedule ID confirmed for this attendee.

countryName.description: Country display name returned for the attendee.

liveRoomUrl.description: Attendee-specific live-room URL; treat as sensitive access information.

localDateTime.description: Scheduled local webinar date/time, with T separator and original time precision; not a UTC instant.

replayRoomUrl.description: Attendee-specific replay-room URL; treat as sensitive access information.

FunctionOutput_webinarjam_registerregist.description: Provider-confirmed attendee registration receipt, not evidence of attendance or notification delivery.

tags.instructions: Use `get-webinar` first for API schedule IDs and custom-field labels/options, and `list-countries` for geography. For a series, register once through its first schedule; do not repeat for every session. Collect the person's required privacy and communication consent before calling. Phone-enabled webinars require an explicit smsConsent value, and registrants from Texas require the appropriate texasTimezone choice. A successful result provides attendee-specific room links, not proof of attendance or message delivery. Do not retry an uncertain registration blindly; check `list-registrants` first.

functions.name: unsubscribe-registrant
functions.description: Unsubscribe one webinar lead from pending webinar notifications without claiming to delete the registration or its attendance history.

webinarId.description: Opaque webinar ID whose notifications are being stopped.

registrantId.description: Lead ID returned as id by list-registrants for this webinar, not an assumed attendee user ID.

FunctionInput_webinarjam_unsubscriberegi.description: The webinar and registrant lead whose pending webinar notifications should stop.

webinarId.description: Webinar ID from the successful request.

registrantId.description: Lead ID from the successful request.

unsubscribed.description: True only after provider-confirmed successful opt-out; pending webinar notifications will not be sent.

FunctionOutput_webinarjam_unsubscribereg.description: A provider-confirmed notification opt-out receipt, not registration deletion or removal of attendance history.

tags.instructions: Obtain the webinar ID and registrant lead ID from `list-registrants`. Do not substitute the attendeeId returned by `register-registrant` unless you have independently confirmed it is the lead ID. This stops pending webinar notifications; it is not registration deletion. No resubscribe operation is available through these tools. Check notification status in `list-registrants` or the webinar dashboard after an uncertain result.
